Written by Even Stevens, who followed producer Ron Haffkine into the studio bathroom to pitch him the song, "When You're in Love with a Beautiful Woman" which first appeared on the band's 1978 album Pleasure and Pain.
Pleasure and Pain is the seventh album from the country rock band Dr.
Top 10 hits, "Sharing the Night Together" and "When You're in Love with a Beautiful Woman".
Both songs also became chart hits in the UK, Canada and Australia.
